Name: Build-ImageFromPlantUML
Purpose: Walks a directory tree and generates PlantUML images (SVG/PNG) from diagram source files with various extensions, mirroring directory structure to output location.

Name: Test-PowerShellSyntax
Purpose: Validates PowerShell script syntax using the AST parser to detect parse errors before execution.

Name: New-MCPServerJunction
Purpose: Creates a directory junction from repository root to SharedVSCode MCP servers folder, making MCP servers accessible throughout the repository.

Name: Get-RepositoryRoot
Purpose: Finds and returns the repository root directory by searching upward through the directory tree for a .git folder.

Name: Remove-ObjAndBinSubDirectories
Purpose: Recursively searches for and removes obj and bin subdirectories from a specified path to clean build artifacts.

Name: Sync-RulesToCSV
Purpose: Exports Rules, RulePrimitives, and related RRSBS tables from the database to CSV files for version control and backup.

Name: Read-SourceAndCreateRules
Purpose: AI-assisted extraction of Rules metadata from source code files (PowerShell, C#, MSBuild, SQL) with parsing of function declarations and comment-based help.
